product_updates.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
product_updates.content: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

product_updates.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
product_updates.content: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

product_updates.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
product_updates.content: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

product_updates.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
product_updates.content: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

product_updates.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
product_updates.content: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

product_updates.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
product_updates.content: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

product_updates.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
product_updates.content: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

product_updates.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
product_updates.content: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

product_updates.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
product_updates.content: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

product_updates.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
product_updates.content: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.
